description: AC EMT benchmark: a 20 kV, 50 Hz source behind its short-circuit impedance (500 MVA, X/R 10, the same in zero sequence, star grounded) feeds a 10 km line (2 coupled pi sections), a 2.5 MVA 20/0.4 kV Dyn11 transformer and a resistive 0.4 kV load (grounded star). simscape_emt_ac_benchmark.m builds it from Simscape Electrical's three-phase blocks; tests/test_emt_ac.py builds Electrisim's circuit from this file. Each case applies one fault at 300 ms for 60 ms, once the energising transient - the line ringing, time constant 2L/R = 40 ms - has died away. SI units.
